features: 4MP Ultra HD Video – Wi-Fi CCTV camera for home indoor with 2560x1440 resolution, H.265 compression for smooth video, low bandwidth use, and sharp detail clarity in every frame.
360° Pan & 59° Tilt Coverage – CP PLUS Wi-Fi camera 360 degree ensures complete room surveillance with wide-angle viewing, eliminating blind spots in homes, shops, and offices.

CTC Cyber Secure Protection – Built with advanced CP PLUS Cyber Trusted Core (CTC) technology, this wifi cctv camera ensures your video data is encrypted and safe, protecting your family’s privacy from cyber threats and hacking.
15M IR Night Vision – CCTV camera with IR LEDs captures clear footage in total darkness up to 15 meters, ensuring reliable monitoring day and night.

Smart Detection Technology – Advanced human detection, sound detection, motion tracking, and instant push alerts ensure accurate monitoring. Unlike basic wifi cameras for home, it avoids false alarms from pets, vehicles, or shadows.

Private Mode for Complete Peace of Mind – Instantly enable privacy mode through the app to pause live monitoring and recording. A key feature in any wifi camera for home or indoor cctv camera for added personal control.

View & Talk Feature – Stay connected with your family, children, or pets through the live View & Talk option. The built-in microphone and speaker let you interact clearly using the Ezykam+ mobile app, even when you are far away.

CLOUD & SD CARD STORAGE FOR Wi-Fi CCTV CAMERA – This CP PLUS 3MP smart Wi-Fi camera offers dual storage support with encrypted cloud recording and local backup via microSD card up to 256GB (card not included), giving you flexible and secure CCTV footage storage options for your smart home or office.
Works with Google Home – Voice control this cp plus wifi camera using smart speakers or displays. Just ask Google to show your live view for hands-free monitoring.

Made in India CP PLUS Wi-Fi Camera for Home – Proudly designed and manufactured in Bharat, this cp plus wifi camera combines smart surveillance features and reliable build quality to offer the best cctv camera experience for Indian homes.
description: Upgrade your home and office security with the CP PLUS 4MP Wi-Fi CCTV Camera for Home Indoor (CP-E45Q), designed to deliver crystal-clear 4MP (2560x1440) resolution with H.265 video compression for smooth streaming and reduced storage usage. This Wi-Fi camera for home offers a 355° pan & 59° tilt view ensuring complete coverage without blind spots, making it an ideal cctv camera for home indoor. The built-in mic, speaker, and two-way talk feature let you stay connected with family or monitor visitors remotely. With 15M IR night vision, built-in siren, and cloud storage support, this cp plus wifi camera 360 degree ensures day-and-night surveillance. Powered by CP PLUS CTC Cyber Secure Tech, it ensures advanced protection of your data and privacy. Easy plug-and-play installation with Wi-Fi and MicroSD card support (up to 256GB) makes it a hassle-free choice for homes, shops, offices, hospitals, and warehouses.
